newsitem.title: USA: Unimark sees Q3 net loss vs year ago profit.
newsitem.headline: Unimark sees Q3 net loss vs year ago profit.

text.p: The UniMark Group Inc said Thursday it expects net sales for the third quarter of about $15 million compared with net sales of $8.3 million for the same period of 1995.
The company said it expects to report a net loss for the third quarter ended September 30. The company reported net income of about $0.12 per share for the same period of 1995.

The company said net income was hurt by higher raw material cost, a lack of sales to Japan, lower than expected sale of orange juice concentrate and additional costs associated with commencing operations at a new plant in the Northeastern United States.
